name: @amykit/plugin-github
description: GitHub as the code host, through the gh CLI.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when the code lives on GitHub. It mounts the code-host port that ticket-to-qa and pull-request need to open pull requests, request reviews and read review threads, and that errand and note-to-plan reach when they open their drafts. It talks to GitHub through the gh CLI, so gh must be installed and logged in.
